Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Aarav - 11 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Meenakshi - 35 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Vikram - 39 years, father
Look: light beard, green T-shirt

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Aarav stands in the courtyard. Meenakshi and Vikram stand near him.]

Vikram: "What lovely weather!"

[Aarav points at the sky.]

Meenakshi (gently): "Show me too!"

[It starts to rain.]

Meenakshi: "Vikram, look at this."

[Suddenly it begins to pour.]

Aarav: "Yes, all right."

[Night falls and the stars come out.]

Vikram: "I'm ready!"

[Dry leaves fall from the trees.]

Vikram: "What next?"

Scene 2: The main road - Day

[Aarav stands on the road. Meenakshi and Vikram stand near him.]

Meenakshi: "What a nice place."

[Father drives the car; Mother sits beside him in the front and Aarav sits in the back seat.]

Aarav (gently): "How beautiful!"

[Aarav sits in the front passenger seat while Mother drives.]

Meenakshi (surprised): "I'm ready!"

[The family gets into the car: Father at the wheel, Aarav in the back.]

Vikram: "What a day to remember!"
